name: aladdin.shadows
description: Elevation is primarily tonal layering; shadow is restrained. Shadows are THEME-AWARE: a component asks for a level (raised / card / overlay) and the theme decides how that level is drawn. The values below are the LIGHT theme; the dark values live in the .dark block of frontend/src/styles/tokens.css.
maintenance: Manually maintained. Edit here first, then DESIGN.md (Elevation & Depth) and frontend/tailwind.config.ts (theme.extend.boxShadow).

raised.usage: The quietest step, consumed as shadow-sm. Light theme.

card.usage: Raised cards on the light (Quartz) theme; real offset + blur.

overlay.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs lifted off the page, consumed as shadow-lg. Light theme.

glow.usage: The Lumen bloom at the Aperture focal point and AI moments ONLY. Never a flat zero-offset halo on generic elements.

rules.tonal-first: On dark, build depth with layered stone surfaces (Carbon -> Carbon 2 -> Carbon 3) and border shifts before reaching for shadow. Reserve glow for Lumen focal moments.
rules.neutral-tint: The light tint is a NEUTRAL near-black, rgba(16,16,18), not the warm rgba(20,16,10) tuned against Limestone. At 4-6% a single shadow's hue is nearly invisible, but there is one under every card on the page and warm ones cast warmth back onto the Quartz ground. Opacity and geometry are the design; the hue is not free.
